ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the bottom middle part of the figure is marked “Harmful algae”, and next to it is a group of black dots representing algae. Arrows point from the algae to shellfish, whales, and fish, showing that the algae are at the base position of the food web and provide food or energy sources for these organisms. Reasoning: In a food web, organisms that are located at the base position and provide food or energy for other organisms belong to producers. Therefore, algae is producer.
